text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my. An offer for me to perform, you say~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At a fan event for kids,
I am to perform an opera for the children, you see!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And I would love for you, Bright-san, to play
the role of the princess opposite me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, the role of a princess. How wonderful~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, I do not have
any acting experience, you know~?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My artistic vision is never mistaken!
Your overflowing elegance and gentle demeanor—you are destined to be the ideal princess for the children!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Above all, the script, the direction, and the lead role are all handled by me! Brilliant success is as good as guaranteed...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, to be discovered by none other than the "Overlord", making your debut as heroine on your very first stage—under what lucky star were you born!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...And so that was the invitation. I was thinking
that I would love to give it a try~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good, doesn't it?
Getting used to the stage will probably come in handy for Winning Lives too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll come watch, too.
I can even help you practice reading the script if you want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
With Dober helping out as well,
there will be nothing to fear~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must practice with all my heart
so the children will enjoy it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the outdoor stage, a show inviting local parents and children to the academy was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To think, dear grandmother~,
that you were the witch all along~♪

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Witch
text_block_list.text:
Meddlesome princess~, I shall lay a curse upon you~♪
Fall into an eternal slumber~♪

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Playing Witch
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ somehow, the strength is leaving my body,
and I am grow~ing... so~... very, slee~py~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good~ night~, every~one~
...Zzz~ zzz~...♪

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Princess~, don't fall asleep~!
Witch, that's totally unfair~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, was I one step too late~♪
O Princess~! What a tragedy~!
Can such a cruel fate be forgiven~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back~, my first meeting with the princess
was when I had barely gained awareness of this world~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ever since my youth, I was~
a handsome, breathtakingly beautiful prince~.
Monopolizing the passionate gazes of the palace ladies~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Opera O's monologue is way too long.
Still, the kids are getting into it, so it's going well.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright is doing great, too.
She's not nervous at all. Maybe she really is cut out for this.)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold, the witch has been vanquished~
and peace has returned to the world~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My young friends!
To awaken the princess, we need your power!
Let us all call out to her together! Ready, and—!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Princessss~, please wake up~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The kids seem shy.
Calling out loudly out of nowhere takes courage, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Well, this is where Bright wakes up,
and they live happily ever after—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... that's not what's in the script...?
Bright, what's wrong...!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*~, *snooze*~, *snooze*~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, she's actually asleep...!?
No way...! This is bad...!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Proud friends! Brave little heroes!
Surely your power cannot be limited to just that!
Come, now is the time to send your passionate feelings to the princess!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Princess! Please!
Wake up!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, keep it up!
The princess's fate rests upon your voices!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, we can do even betterrr!
Princessss! Wake uuup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Spurred on by TM Opera O, the children's voices grew in number and volume—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: PRINCESSSS!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...*yaaawn*. What a lovely sleep that was~.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy!
The princess woke up!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, young heroes!
The strong feelings in each of your hearts have awakened the princess from her deep slumber!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Because we all tried our best!
Yaaay!!
With the children's smiles and cheers combining to create a great sense of unity, the show came to a close to rave reviews.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... I wondered what would happen...
Falling asleep for real during your debut stage performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, while reviewing my lines last night,
I accidentally ended up staying up quite late~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright, you've really got endless guts, or maybe you're just built different...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent performance!
Ah, my own keen eye for talent frightens me...! To have unearthed an unpolished diamond such as yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my♪ To receive such praise from you
is truly an honor~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Especially that ad-lib in the final scene!
To deliberately ignore the initial calls to draw the children deeper into the stage... brilliant...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your ad-lib breathed life into the production and brought about the grandest finale!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alright, it is decided! Bright-san, you must join my next hometown performance as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you would invite me once more~?
If someone like me will suffice, I would be delighted~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so Mejiro Bright was showered with lavish praise by a slightly misunderstanding TM Opera O.
